official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description: Separate one actual MP3/WAV music clip up to 120 seconds and 20 MB into selected vocal and instrument estimates. Choose WAV or MP3, then play and download each returned stem separately. Supports vocals, drums, bass, other, guitar and piano; absence of a returned file is reported. Bleed and missing detail may occur. Does not create music or grant rights. Requires a connected account. NebulaCafe and its providers process audio; public links are accessible to anyone holding them.

limitations_ja: 入力はMP3/WAVの1ファイル、最大120秒・20MB。音漏れや欠落が起こり得る。アカウント連携が必要で公開リンクは所持者が閲覧できる。
